rule_findings.finding: S3 bucket 'reports' has no server-side encryption configuration
rule_findings.evidence: resource "aws_s3_bucket" "reports" found with no matching SSE configuration
rule_findings.risk_impact: The bucket's encryption is not declared, so it can't be reviewed or kept consistent. S3 has encrypted new objects with SSE-S3 by default since January 2023, so this alone does not mean data is unencrypted; objects written earlier, and any need for a customer-managed KMS key, need checking.
rule_findings.recommendation: Attach aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration to declare the intended encryption: SSE-S3, or SSE-KMS where you need to control who can decrypt.

rule_findings.finding: No aws_cloudtrail resource found in the submitted Terraform
rule_findings.evidence: No resource of type aws_cloudtrail present in parsed configuration
rule_findings.risk_impact: This code defines no trail. One may be managed elsewhere, such as an organization trail. If none exists, CloudTrail keeps only 90 days of management events in Event history, with no long-term record and no data events (such as S3 object reads) for audit or incident response.
rule_findings.recommendation: Confirm whether an organization or account trail already exists. If not, add an aws_cloudtrail resource covering all regions with log file validation enabled.

rule_findings.finding: IAM role 'bounded_worker' is used by running code and has AdministratorAccess
rule_findings.evidence: resource "aws_iam_role" "bounded_worker" trusts a compute service (EC2, Lambda, ECS tasks or EKS pods) and has AdministratorAccess attached
rule_findings.risk_impact: These attached policies have broad scope. A permissions boundary is configured; effective permissions require evaluating that boundary and other applicable policies.
rule_findings.recommendation: Replace the managed policy with a customer-managed one that names only the actions and resource ARNs this workload uses.

terraform_resources.note: Only the settings named for each resource were checked. A setting not named here may still be set in the code: never describe it as missing. "copies" is how many instances count or for_each creates ("unknown" when it can't be worked out from the code); a resource without it is created once. "rules" on a backup plan lists each backup rule: its schedule, how many days recovery points are kept, and whether they are copied to another vault. rules_total and rules_truncated disclose omitted backup rules; when truncated, copy rules and short retention are prioritized and source_index is one-based.
